aggregation: Mean of all state totals in each round; arithmetic mean of three round means; round only final outputs to one decimal.
model_policy: Any configured vision-capable provider/model; bind provider, requested model, model version, returned identity, parameters, endpoint hash and capability receipt.
infrastructure_policy: Missing or altered collected evidence, capture transport failure, API failure and invalid VLM output invalidate the run; never substitute zero.
capture_stage: After dynamic cases; independent clean process for each state.
